about_the_game: Cozy Isle is a relaxing, Ghibli-inspired town building game. Throw coins into the town fountain to receive charming decor. Help the townsfolk with their tasks to invite more special visitors. Bring wonder back to the world in this peaceful idler.

short_description: The town needs your help! Restore a forgotten village in this cozy, Ghibli-inspired game. Toss coins into a magical fountain to receive charming buildings and decor, bringing life back to the village. No rush, no stress—just a peaceful journey to make the town feel like home again.
